title: Key West Private Sandbar Charter with Swimming & Snorkeling
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This private Key West sandbar charter gives your group flexibility to swim, wade, float, snorkel, or relax at a pace that suits you. Rather than promising one fixed destination, the captain selects an appropriate sandbar or shallow-water area based on tides, weather, depth, traffic, safety, and operating conditions.
